summary: Develop workplace AI guardrails for inclusion, accessibility and automation impacts. Explore the course and assess fit for your team.
lede: Inclusive AI and DEI governance helps HR, DEI, product and transformation teams assess workplace AI’s effects on workforce groups. Participants practise reviewing workforce data and decision workflows, comparing subgroup outcomes, checking accessibility and mapping automation impacts. They also develop practical safeguards, decision rights and communication plans, using ISO 30415:2021 and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework as references.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make, govern or explain decisions about AI-enabled hiring, employee services, workplace analytics and automation. It is particularly suited to cross-functional teams that need a shared way to assess inclusion and workforce impact.
modules: NIST AI RMF for Workforce Impact
OECD AI Principles and Workforce Communication
prerequisites: Working familiarity with at least one area such as DEI, HR and talent, data science, AI product delivery, compliance or transformation. No coding or model-building experience is required.
